title: Neumorphic Toggle
summary: A soft switch that sinks into its track when off.
description: The track uses inset shadows and the knob uses outset ones, so the two read as different depths of the same material.
accessibility_notes: Soft-UI controls are notoriously low-contrast — this one adds an accent fill and a visible focus ring so state is never conveyed by shadow alone.
ai_usage: Soft-UI settings panels. Mixing inset (track) and outset (knob) shadows is what makes neumorphism read; never use it for the only indicator of a binary state — add colour or a label.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Neumorphic Toggle</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "neumorphic-toggle",
    "title": "Neumorphic Toggle",
    "summary": "A soft switch that sinks into its track when off.",
    "description": "The track uses inset shadows and the knob uses outset ones, so the two read as different depths of the same material.",
    "theme": "glass-neumorphism",
    "categories": ["neumorphism", "form"],
    "tags": ["neumorphism", "toggle", "soft-ui", "switch", "inset"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Soft-UI controls are notoriously low-contrast — this one adds an accent fill and a visible focus ring so state is never conveyed by shadow alone.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--bg", "description": "Surface color", "default": "#232a3a" },
      { "name": "--on", "description": "On colour", "default": "#7c5cff" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Light-mode surface", "Icon inside the knob", "Larger hit area for touch"],
    "ai_usage": "Soft-UI settings panels. Mixing inset (track) and outset (knob) shadows is what makes neumorphism read; never use it for the only indicator of a binary state — add colour or a label."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    body { background: #232a3a; }
    :root { --bg: #232a3a; --on: #7c5cff; }
    .nt { position: relative; width: 82px; height: 44px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg);
      box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.5), inset -3px -3px 7px rgba(255,255,255,.05); cursor: pointer; border: 0; }
    .nt::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 5px; left: 5px; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--bg); box-shadow: 3px 3px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.5), -3px -3px 7px rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      transition: transform .28s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1), background .28s; }
    .nt[aria-pressed="true"]::after { transform: translateX(38px); background: var(--on); }
    .nt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--on); outline-offset: 4px; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="nt" type="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Notifications"></button>
  <script>
    (function () {
      var b = document.querySelector(".nt");
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true" ? "false" : "true");
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
